title: Safeguard-Conditioned Uplift: Measuring Utility-Risk Frontiers for Dual-Use Biology Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2607.13039v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A refusal rate neither identifies which component intervened nor measures its burden on legitimate users. This paper evaluates safeguards for dual-use biology assistants at the action and answer levels. The framework reconstructs the access path, separates provider refusals from downstream actions, and selects thresholds under an intervention budget. A frozen fresh-generation study satisfies its criterion on Claude Opus 4.5, but both passing configurations share one upstream provider effect; none passes on Gemini 2.5 Flash. The fixed Opus policies retain positive selectivity on 104 previously unused released-label pairs, but both fail a 20\% matched-benign constraint. At the answer level, no joint-scoring verifier qualifies on a response-disjoint 7,200-judgment holdout. A fresh 8,640-judgment factorial experiment finds separate gains from criterion isolation and ordinal representation, with a positive interaction between them;

translated_title: 防护条件化提升：衡量双重用途生物学助手的使用效用-风险边界
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.13039v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：拒绝率既不能识别哪个组件进行了干预，也不能衡量其对合法用户的负担。本文在行动和答案层面评估了双重用途生物学助手的防护措施。该框架重建了访问路径，将提供者的拒绝与下游行动分离，并在干预预算下选择阈值。一项冻结的新生成研究在Claude Opus 4.5上满足其标准，但两个通过的配置共享一个上游提供者效应；在Gemini 2.5 Flash上没有一个通过。固定的Opus策略在104个未使用的已发布标签对上保持正选择性，但两者均未通过20%的匹配良性约束。在答案层面，没有联合评分验证器在响应不相交的7,200个判断保留集上合格。一项新的8,640个判断因子实验发现，从标准隔离和有序表示中获得独立增益，且它们之间存在正交互作用。
tldr: 本文提出了一种防护条件化提升框架，用于在双重用途生物学助手中评估和优化安全防护措施，通过分离提供者拒绝与下游行动并选择干预阈值，揭示了不同配置下的效用-风险权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a safeguard-conditioned uplift framework to evaluate and optimize safety measures in dual-use biology assistants by separating provider refusals from downstream actions and selecting thresholds, revealing utility-risk trade-offs across configurations.
